verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Ice Age and New Phyrexia definitions. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim. Karn restart remains unchanged for a focused follow-up.
review_notes: 28 alpha-only definitions retain exact tokens after declared local substitutions; 43 structured definitions receive focused source review and one combined target build.
Preserve repeated mana/payment queries, direct-mana paths, info-slot writes, post-payment fizzle handling, parent/activation target-slot differences, charge colors and native AI decisions.

Land Cap retains untap/upkeep routing and trigger rechecks; Glacial Chasm retains separate trigger/static humiliation checks and ETB sacrifice order. Lim-Dul payment blocks retain fresh current-turn reads across callbacks.

Granted aura abilities retain attached-source snapshots, target-definition order, grantor selection, resolution queries and ordinary aura events. Soul Kiss keeps CHECK_ABILITIES separate from activation routing, including the original card-instance query count.
Mana override loops write seven entries and preserve the initial card-count snapshot plus live scan bounds. Marton retains two separate reverse scans and the attack query for self.

Hex Parasite retains post-selection max-X snapshot/restore, live counter queries, removal callbacks and post-callback info-slot decrement. Integer arithmetic replaces the decompiler function-pointer alias for the same 32-bit slot.
Batterskull retains ETB generation, equipment queries, target mismatch exits and bounce/equip routing. Bludgeon Brawl retains detach callbacks and source/control/static-event distinctions.
No historical replay, native semantic harness, new tests or reccmp refresh for this readability batch. Karn is deliberately unchanged.
status: Applied 71-definition readability batch. One combined target build and a compact coverage receipt follow; reccmp refresh deferred.
